source.note: Canonical SRD spells-per-day tables (Sorcerer and Wizard) and SRD bonus-spell mapping.
source.bonus_table_source: SRD Ability Modifiers and Bonus Spells

notes.specialist_evoker: Specialist wizard (Evoker) does not change the wizard base slots. It grants one extra prepared spell of the specialty school per spell level per day. This is applied to prepared spells, not to base slots.
notes.bonus_application: To apply bonus spells: compute ability modifier = floor((score - 10)/2). Use bonusMap[modifier] (if modifier >=1). Only add a bonus for spell level L if caster level >= minCasterLevelForSpellLevel[L].
notes.example: If wizard effective level = 6 and Int total = 17 (mod = 3), base wizard slots for level 6 are [4,3,3,2,0,...]. bonusMap[3] = [0,1,1,1,...]. Apply bonuses for levels where caster level >= minCasterLevel: 1,2,3 -> final slots before specialist = [4,4,4,3,...]. If Evoker specialist applies, add +1 prepared spell per level for the evocation school -> prepared counts for evocation become [5,5,5,4] for 0-3.
